title: Bell Canada says 'agentic' threat actor stole enterprise customer data; residential customers also affected
date_note: Date of the incident as stated in Bell's statement to BleepingComputer; the article was published 20 November.
geo_basis: country; the article gives no city
summary: Bell says an agentic threat actor accessed some of its systems on 17 November, including one used to order and provision circuits, and took some enterprise customer data from a pre-production Maximo environment (BleepingComputer, per a customer notice). The Globe and Mail reports Bell told residential customers they were also affected: names, addresses, phone numbers, emails and account details, but no card or bank information, Bell says. Bell says it contained the incident.
plain: Bell Canada says an attacker it calls 'agentic' took some business customer data and also affected residential customers. Bell says no credit card or bank details were taken and services were not affected.
exec: Bell says some enterprise customer data was taken and residential customers were also affected; Bell says no credit card or bank information was affected and customer services were not impacted.
action: General advice: Bell enterprise customers should follow Bell's notification and check the indicators of compromise Bell says it shared with customers and the Canadian Centre for Cyber Security.
impact: Some enterprise customer data exfiltrated and residential customers affected (names, addresses, phone numbers, emails, account details, per Bell); Bell reports no impact to customer services.

sources.name: BleepingComputer: Bell Canada says 'agentic' hacker stole enterprise customer data
Europe Says (relaying CBC News): Bell says it's investigating cyberattack that led to potential theft of business customer data
The Globe and Mail: Bell Canada residential customers affected by cybersecurity incident

validation.note: BleepingComputer and CBC News (read as relayed, uncredited, by europesays.com; CBC original not found) each quote Bell's own statement on the agentic actor, the ordering system, containment and no service impact. Bell's notification itself was not read. The Globe and Mail (23 November) quotes Bell's emails to residential customers and a spokesperson statement.

review.note: stronger than the source: exec said residential data was taken and added major telecom; Globe says affected. Rest matches BleepingComputer and Globe and Mail
